description: This file contains extension methods for the ISerializerBuilder interface, specifically adding support for Protobuf serialization and deserialization of IMessage types using dependency injection. It defines methods to register codecs and related services for Protobuf serialization within the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: SerializationHostingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to enhance ISerializerBuilder with Protobuf serialization support.

methods.name: AddProtobufSerializer
methods.description: Adds support for serializing and deserializing Protobuf IMessage types by registering appropriate codecs and services in the serializer builder.
